objective: Test whether complete point-in-time disclosure titles add net marginal alpha beyond the same-data V13 two-stage baseline without increasing portfolio risk.
accepted_candidate_source: announcements only if the pre-registered external-data audit passes

rejected_candidate_sources.northbound_holdings: coverage below the pre-registered 350-symbol minimum and series stops in 2024

anti_leakage.announcement_effective_time: next available trading day after publication date
anti_leakage.historical_membership: point-in-time CSI 300 membership and official historical weights
anti_leakage.feature_selection: training years only; stable direction in at least 4 years

model.event_line: LightGBM top-20-percent classifier times positive conditional L1 magnitude
model.final_score: 80 percent event line plus 20 percent V10 global line

new_event_feature_gate.minimum_years: expanding-window minimum of all event years available at that fold, capped at 4; at least 1

decision_policy: Freeze data, code, dependencies and environment before the first V14 performance run. Failed sources stay excluded. Failed retrospective gates keep V6 in production.
